description:
List the constituents of an ETF.

    Base mode (default): returns every holding with its weight % in the
    index — {ticker, name, weight_pct}.

    Top-performers mode: pass `sort_by` (one of '5d', 'month', 'ytd',
    'year') and a `limit` > 0 to get the top N constituents by that
    period's return. Each row carries weight_pct, current_price,
    return_pct for the chosen period, and analyst_consensus.

    Use the top-performers mode for questions like 'which stocks in XLK
    rose most this week' without separately calling a screener.

limit.description: With sort_by: how many top performers to return (1-50). Without sort_by, or at 0, the full holdings list comes back unranked. A negative or non-numeric limit is REJECTED rather than treated as 0.
limit.title: Limit

sort_by.description: Optional period to rank constituents by return, descending: '5d', 'month', 'ytd' or 'year'. Set limit with it (1-50); sort_by with limit 0 returns the full unranked list. Use it only for questions about the best-performing constituents. For the holdings themselves ("top 10 holdings", largest positions, weights, the full list) leave it empty: every row carries weight_pct.
sort_by.title: Sort By

name: get_etf_holdings
